calls.reason: Goldman's tallies support the debt part, but the central charge that big buyers mostly aren't using GPUs rests only on one report of some Amazon racks awaiting power.
Goldman's figures leave about $293B outside hyperscalers, but that covers all AI-related debt, not data centers only. Nothing establishes that most deals are project-financed.
A multiyear forecast with only weeks elapsed. Alphabet notes a depreciation headwind and Microsoft beat expectations, but no multiyear results exist yet.
UBP estimates over $1.25T in commitments, close to the figure, but no evidence measures whether those commitments distorted compute demand.
The call transcript claims customer acceptance within 24 hours. The only independent load data is from June, before the statements, so 'misleading' can't be judged.
Nothing maps NVIDIA revenue to buyers' installation timing. The 10-Q notes multi-year infrastructure builds, and NVIDIA's 'fully utilized' claim is self-reported.
